t: Ideal for medium to high traffic areas, this template adjustable overhead door closer is suitable for door widths up to 1100mm wide and up to 80kg. Features adjustable closing speed and latch action. Fits to ‘push’ or ‘pull’ side of the door. Ideal for offices, corridors and residential facilities.
b: Universal Fittings for Regular, Transom or Parallel Mount Fitting
Adjustment Screws Reduce Risk of Vandalism
